fear_difference.3: Stress cues for Candidate 3 might be that efforts are fruitless, undervalued, or goals are out of focus.
fear_difference.7: Stress cues for Candidate 7s may be options being closed, being stuck for a long time, or having a lack of outlets for heavy issues.

stress_reaction_difference.3: Candidate 3s may be more likely to speed up, adapt to expectations, and prioritize delivering visible results when under pressure.
stress_reaction_difference.7: Candidate Sevens may be more likely to open up new options, shift attention, and lighten the pace to reduce discomfort when under pressure.

relationship_difference.3: Candidate No. 3 may value being recognized, trusted, and having visible returns on investment in relationships.
relationship_difference.7: Candidate Sevens may value space, ease, shared exploration, and not being overly restrictive in relationships.

work_difference.3: Candidate 3 may look first to goals, results, and external feedback more often in work situations. This is not a conclusion about job ability or career suitability.
work_difference.7: Candidate 7s may more often look first at opportunities, ideas, and future scalability in work situations. This is not a conclusion about job ability or career suitability.

entries.seven_day_observation_question: Keep track of only specific situations for the next seven days: When you tense up, push forward, or step back, is it more like the “possibility, options, and keeping the future open” of Candidate 7, or the “results, efficiency, and visible value” of Candidate 3?

entries.short_compare_copy: Close-call can only mean that both candidates No. 7 and No. 3 are worthy of observation and should be observed side by side; it is not a two-choice judgment type, nor can it infer diagnosis, recruitment screening or career decisions.

entries.shared_surface_similarity: On the surface, both may have strength and boundaries, but the difference often arises in who takes priority between protecting the initiative and calibrating legitimacy. close-call only means that the candidate explanations are similar and you need to go back to the recent situation and observe them side by side.

core_motivation_difference.1: Candidate 1 is more likely to organize attention around standards, accountability, and getting things done right.
core_motivation_difference.8: Candidate 8s are more likely to organize their attention around boundaries, taking initiative, and protecting what matters.

fear_difference.8: Stress cues for Candidate 8s might be being controlled, having boundaries crossed, or having important boundaries interpreted by others.

stress_reaction_difference.1: Candidate 1 may correct mistakes, tighten standards, and raise demands on themselves more often under pressure.
stress_reaction_difference.8: Candidate 8s may more often increase their intensity, clear obstacles, and clear boundaries between responsibilities under pressure.

relationship_difference.1: Candidate 1 may value principles, propriety, reliability and mutual responsibility in relationships.
relationship_difference.8: Candidate 8s may value candor, a sense of strength, clear boundaries, and mutual respect in relationships.

work_difference.8: Candidate No. 8 may first look at authority, responsibility, decision-making authority, and whether they can advance directly in a work situation. This is not a conclusion about job ability or career suitability.
